## Full text

### Page 1 (OCR, spell-checked: 6 words corrected)

```text
WAAD-BECK BYBTEMB LTD:
CIRCUIT DESCRIPIIQN
SA44-058 REGULATOR ASSEMBLY
The constant current source Q2 isolates the incremental changes of the unregulated dc input voltage from the control current leaving the collector of Q4 and entering the basc of Q3.
Q3 is 2 current amplifier designed to drive the series pass power transistor Ql the main frame assembly of the M648 or M648A_
04 is level shifter which shifts the output voltage from the regulator UI from +24 volts to +48 volts_
UI contains nominal 1.7 volt precision reference and comparison amplifier: The comparison voltage appearing at pin 6 of UI is derived from the sampling voltage divider consisting of R13 _ R14 and R1S: Adjustment of R14 is used to set the output voltage to exactly +48 volts: Ul derives its supply voltage from the +48 volt regu- lated output via voltage divider R8 and R9, appearing at pins 2 and 3 of the IC. Thc sampling voltage divider Rl3 through to RlS may be effectively extended to remote load via the sensing voltage terminals at pins and 7 of  the SA14-058 assembly. This remote  sensing feature maintain constant load   voltages for loads remote from the power supply  (refer drawing B648-02-003 (M648) B648-02-005 (M648A) for interconnecting detail)
R12 and R16 are effectively shorted out the interconnecting leads from the sense terminals and load terminals_ the event that thc sense leads become dis- connected, the power supply's reference divider network is still allowed to sample the +48 volt output through those resistors   preventing possible failures the supply or the load.
Q1 monitors the output load current by sensing the voltage drop across the resistor between pins and the regulator card; R3 drawing B 648-02-002 (M648) B 648-02-004 (M6484). When the supply current approaches 1.5 amps, Q1 begins conduct; which turn decreases the conduction of current source Q2 current limiting the scrics regulator_ This reduces the  regulated output   voltage which reduces the reverse bias applied to Q1 set by R4 and R7 permitting Q1 to conduct harder: This regenerative process reduces both output voltage and current thereby reducing the power dissipation the series regulator during any overload condit- ions:
Ovcr voltage protection is effected by the crowbar circuit consisting of SCR CR4 and zener diode CR3_ If for any reason the output voltage rises bove +56 volts CR3 will begin conduct supplying gate current CR4 causing fire. large current will drawn through RI, sce drawing B 648-02-002 (M648) 648-02-004 (M648A), on thc main frame assembly of the M648 or M6484 resulting the blowing of fuse FZ. C8 decreases thc sensitivity of the crowbar overvoltage circuit, preventing it from firing due any momentary load transients which may occur
```
